resources.string: Connect each phone to the same server. Create a room, share its code, then play a track. Queue, playback and position stay in sync.
Needed to create rooms only. At least 16 characters, matching your server configuration.
Could not save server settings. Try again.
Use your computer’s network address, such as http://192.168.1.10:8787, or your hosted HTTPS server. Hosts enter the server token; guests can join using an invite without it.
Configure your server to create or join an online room.
Each phone needs internet access to play shared online tracks. Files imported on one phone are not streamed to the others. Speaker and Bluetooth latency may vary.
